signConventions.dt: t_CG(event) - t_truth(event) [s]; negative = the 3DCG shows the event earlier
signConventions.dS: -dt * v [m]; along-track position of the 3DCG minus the real car at the same instant; positive = 3DCG ahead
signConventions.dLat: CG distance-to-kerb minus true distance-to-kerb [m]; positive = the 3DCG shows the car farther from the kerb. For a kerb contact = CG gap at the truth onset (true gap 0).
signConventions.gap: inner tyre outer edge to the kerb line (T4/apex_kpi); negative = on the kerb
signConventions.L: video offset: true lap t of a frame = overlay-mapped lap t + L (T2)

labels.measured: directly from logger samples, video pixels/audio (by T1-T3) or the viewer pose re-run (T4)
labels.derived: arithmetic combination of measured values (differences, products with speed, statistics)
labels.estimated: depends on an assumption stated next to it (camera scale, physical model, line semantics)

familyDefinitions.contactFirstBlock: kerb contact, camera-free: CG first crossing of the block line by the nearest inner tyre minus the IMU vibration onset (T1, audio-confirmed where available); primary contacts (high/medium, not steering-away, line defined); only passes where the CG shows contact
familyDefinitions.contactFirstBlock_exclK1: as contactFirstBlock without k1 (Coca-Cola), whose CG block line closes at ~12 m/s at the truth onset (leading-end geometry)
familyDefinitions.contactMidBlock: midpoint of the CG block-contact run minus midpoint of the truth vibration (onset..offset); truth offsets trail the tyre leaving the kerb (decay), so this is biased negative; reference only
familyDefinitions.contactFirstPaint: as contactFirstBlock with the paint line (road-side start of the white strip); the paint line lies road-side of the blocks, so negative by construction
familyDefinitions.videoTipNominal: video clipping point (T3 tip, row 276) after the T2 offset, T3 nominal camera f967/h1.26 (f*h 1218); absolute value camera-dependent
familyDefinitions.videoTipSpecFovCamera: same tips with the spec-FOV camera f711/h1.25 (f*h 889, SmartyCam 84 deg FOV spec, h from road width 1.26 m)
familyDefinitions.videoKerbEnds: video red-block leading/trailing end crossing row 276 (T3) after the T2 offset, nominal camera; first/last block colour ambiguity up to ~1 block
familyDefinitions.turnInHeading50: turn-in: CG drawn-heading-rate t50 minus IMU gyro t50, both cgpose.rate_onset, IMU boxcar-filtered 1.2 s to match the viewer chord heading; quality-gated
familyDefinitions.turnInVisibleT10: visible turn-in: CG drawn-heading-rate t10 minus the UNSMOOTHED IMU gyro t10 (same rule); includes the lead caused by the +-0.6 s chord heading
familyDefinitions.yawRatePeak: telemetry clipping marker: CG drawn yaw-rate peak minus IMU (chord-matched) yaw-rate peak; flat peaks make it noisy
familyDefinitions.minSpeed: telemetry clipping marker: minimum of the CG position-derived speed minus the minimum of the non-driven rear wheels (T1)

straightLineCheckT3.definition: main straight 380-680 m: video camera-to-left-road-edge distance from the two edge-line slopes and the road width (camber-corrected), minus the replay camera position relative to the CG left road edge; per-frame differences, median per lap. Not at kerbs; a second lateral truth source.

C1_videoTimeOffset.what: true lap t of a video frame = overlay-mapped lap t + L (per lap from the SmartyCam data track + 7/30 calibration, or one session constant)
C1_videoTimeOffset.metric: same-rule IMU accelerometer onset50 minus kerb-audio onset50 after the offset (s), audio confidence high+medium; LOLO = calibration / session constant estimated without the held-out lap

C2_alongTrackOffset_fromContacts.what: move the drawn car along its own heading by a (m; + = forward; = an antenna-to-vehicle-centre offset), a = -median(dS of the block first contact) of the training laps

C2b_alongTrackOffset_fromVideoTips.what: same correction, a = -median(dS of the video tip, nominal camera) of the training laps

C4_jointLateralAlong_fromContacts.what: robust fit over contacts of gapAtOnset = deltaLat - closingRate * tau (deltaLat: CG farther from kerb, tau: CG ahead in time)
C4_jointLateralAlong_fromContacts.caveat: tau is driven by the events with large closing rates (k1: ~12 m/s, i.e. the CG block line meets the path at ~20 deg near its leading end); a negative tau (CG behind) contradicts the heading timing (CG heading leads the gyro by 0.00-0.05 s) and the median first-contact timing, so it is read as kerb-line geometry, not as a pose offset

C6_perKerbAlongTrack.what: per-kerb along-track shift of the kerb line (or a local along-track error), = median dS of the block first contact at that kerb on the OTHER laps (>= 2), else 0

C7_perKerbLateral.what: per-kerb lateral shift of the block line, = median CG gap at the truth onset at that kerb on the OTHER laps (>= 2), else 0

C5_poseTimeShift.what: shift the drawn pose in time (t -> t + tau). Rejected as a correction if the drawn heading already matches the IMU yaw: a pose time shift moves the heading too.
